This directory vendors static FFmpeg 9.0.1 (x64-windows) libraries and
headers, limited to the avcodec, avutil, and swresample components used
by AACDecoder_FFmpeg / AACDecoder_LATM. The libraries are linked into the
executable, so no FFmpeg DLLs are needed at run time.

FFmpeg source for this version: https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/releases/tag/n9.0.1

Build: build_static_msvc.cmd (build_static_msvc.sh) in this directory,
with Visual Studio 2022 (v143) and MSYS (bash, make, nasm). Only the aac
and aac_latm decoders are enabled. One set of libraries is built per MSVC
runtime library:

- lib/MT   /MT   (Release)
- lib/MTd  /MTd  (Debug)
- lib/MD   /MD   (Release_MD)

The configuration does not include --enable-gpl, --enable-version3, or
--enable-nonfree, so this build is licensed under the GNU Lesser General
Public License (LGPL) version 2.1 or later. No additional codec libraries
(x264, x265, fdk-aac, etc.) are linked in.

Bundled library versions:
- libavcodec 63.1.101
- libavutil 61.1.101
- libswresample 7.1.101

License text: COPYING.LGPLv2.1 (this directory)
FFmpeg source and legal info: https://ffmpeg.org/legal.html
